items.video_title: Fixing The Annoying Suspension Noise In Your Honda City 2015
items.video_description:
Honda City 2015 Suspension Noise Fix + Fan Motor Replaced
So this subscriber came to us with a lot of noise in his 2015 Honda City's suspension. After checking we found that almost all the suspension parts were worn out and needed to be replaced. this was the first time this car was getting its suspension fixed since it was bought back in 2015. I think its enough that the stock suspension lasted 8 years and over 1 lak kms.
After checking the suspension we found that we would have to replace its shockers, mounts, link rods, jumping rod bushes, control arms and a radiator fan motor.

items.video_title: We Did A Complete Suspension & Steering Overhaul On Both Honda City | Honda City Suspension Noise
items.video_description:
We had these two Honda City's visit one of our MotoFyx car repair workshop for an annual service along with a concern relating to those of abnormal noises being heard from the front side of the car while driving especially across uneven road surfaces along with another strange metallic noise being particularly observed while turning the steering across turns. With driving the car becoming increasingly unstable overtime, the car owners both reached out to us for immediate assistance.

Upon a detailed inspection of both cars by our expert technicians, the front & Rear suspension on both the cars were observed to be weak with the front shock absorbers having gone completely hard and requiring immediate replacement. The suspension link rods also required replacement. the steering rack was observed with significant play along with the end ball joints.

*Function of the steering rack:
- Steering rack consists rack and pinion gears, whose primary function is to convert the rotational motion from the steering wheel onto linear motion required in order to turn the car’s wheels

*Symptoms of a faulty steering rack:
- Steering fluid leakage
- Grinding noise while steering
- Car pulling to one side

*Function of shock absorbers:
- Shock absorbers are designed to absorb or dampen the compression and rebound of the springs and suspension
- Shock absorbers control the unwanted and excess spring motion, thereby keeping the car’s tyres firmly in contact with the road at all times

*Symptoms of weak shock absorbers:
- Abnormal noise observed from the suspension & steering system
- Premature / Uneven tyre wear
- Accelerated wear of shock absorbers
- Instability / Excess vibration while driving
- Poor wheel alignment

*Solution:
